record.one_liner: Customer messaging, helpdesk and support platform with a REST API for contacts, conversations and tickets.
record.auth_notes: Private apps use an Access Token from the developer hub; public apps use OAuth.
record.access_notes: Developer workspaces are free and intended for development purposes only.
record.api_notes: Docs cover managing contacts, conversations and tickets; API version 2.18 per FAQ.
record.blocker_notes: Official MCP server is US and EU only; AU hosted workspaces not yet supported. Public apps need OAuth.
